Action.input_port: Robot state to request: IDLE, DRIVE, SHOOT, AIM or AUTO
Action.description: Ask the robot for a state and wait until it is in it (SUCCESS) or the state fails (FAILURE)

Condition.input_port: Robot state to check: IDLE, DRIVE, SHOOT, AIM, AIMING, AUTO or FOLLOW_PATH
Condition.description: The robot is in the given state

Action.description: Drive a Choreo path until the end of it is reached
